prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE final game environment concept board for a redesigned ENTERABLE kiosk matching an existing top-down game.
Input image: current game screenshot, used ONLY as style, scale, material and camera reference. The protruding side entrance in that screenshot is the rejected design. REMOVE it completely.

Primary design: FRONT/SOUTH ENTRY on the LOWER FACE of the building, and ONE SALES WINDOW/COUNTER to its RIGHT. Do not use a west side entrance. Use the same axis-aligned, almost top-down 2.5D orthographic camera as the screenshot: north is up, building footprint rectangle, roof seams vertical, front facade a shallow upright band at bottom. No diagonal isometric view and no perspective rotation. The doorway MUST appear in the south facade facing the viewer, which matches the game's existing door-and-wall grammar.

Produce a restrained clean two-panel landscape concept board titled "小卖铺 · 正面入口方案". Left panel label "室外 · 正门与售货窗口"; right panel "室内 · 屋顶隐藏". Both panels show the EXACT SAME kiosk layout, same camera and same scale. The design must look ready to be built from top-down game sprites, not a architectural rendering.

EXTERIOR LEFT PANEL:
A compact modest factory-campus kiosk with a COMPLETE RECTANGULAR muted sage corrugated-metal roof, a small ventilation unit and subtle aged fasteners. Roof silhouette is unbroken, no corner cutout, no L-shaped notch and no roof hole. Remove all side-door appendages; left and right side walls meet the front facade cleanly. Cream worn plaster facade, dark sage lower band, honey-brown sales counter. A shallow continuous green corrugated awning across the front connects visibly to the building. The shop name sign "小卖铺" centered above the facade without covering the doorway.
FRONT LEFT THIRD is a clear OPEN entrance in the south facade. Doorless rectangular opening, thin cream wall returns, a narrow green edge, no out-swinging leaf. Shaded internal jamb faces and a slight glimpse of indoor floor/shelf establish real indoor depth. Floor runs continuously NORTH from the outside pavement through this opening, no step or threshold barrier. The opening is wide enough for the orange-clad game character, around 1.2 times character height wide, with believable head clearance. Small "入口" plate next to jamb and modest lamp mounted on actual front wall, no floating posts.
FRONT RIGHT TWO THIRDS is the original-style stocked sales window: honey-brown counter, biscuits, colorful packaged daily goods, glass drink bottles, register and ONE blue-clad vendor behind the same counter. Closed shop walls elsewhere, no duplicate cashier or extra counter. A small trash bin may remain at the far right as in the reference. Place ONE orange-clad protagonist below the front left entry, facing north toward the threshold, clearly showing where to enter.
Existing simple gray campus pavement around building, modest strip of grass outside. Crop away all HUD, control overlays and most neighboring structures. Preserve restrained game textures and muted colors.

INTERIOR RIGHT PANEL:
The SAME complete roof is hidden to reveal the store's rectangular interior. Same front doorway on lower left, ONE original sales counter/window remains at lower right with ONE same blue-clad vendor. Absolutely NO extra interior cash counter, no second vendor. Wooden stocked goods shelving against NORTH wall, one small supply cabinet along right wall. Clear straight north-south walking aisle from lower-left entrance into the left/center interior, with sensible space around shelves. Modest slightly darker gray indoor floor, small soft wall shadows. Walls drawn using the screenshot's shallow top-down 2.5D edge and front-face convention. Place ONE orange-clad protagonist just inside the front door. The only change between panels is roof visibility and player position; footprint, wall positions, counter and vendor must match.

Materials/style: understated hand-painted raster game environment, same sage metal, cream gray plaster and aged golden-brown wood as the reference; neutral overhead daytime lighting, crisp grounded edges, no shiny photorealism, no cartoon inflatable proportions. Soft parchment margin, clean Chinese labels. Do NOT draw side portals, separate freestanding doorway units, skinny hanging green bars, huge porch, missing roof corner, opaque void where ground should be, giant road markings, new architecture style or HUD. No watermark. The entry should read immediately because it follows the existing game camera and facade direction.
scope: Concept only; user requested a fresh design before implementation.
